The '''2022 Copa Libertadores group stage''' was played from 5 April to 26 May 2022.<ref name="fixture_pdf">{{cite web|title=CONMEBOL LIBERTADORES 2022 PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS – FASE DE GRUPOS|url=https://www.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Fixture-Libertadores_Fase-de-Grupos-CL-2022.pdf |publisher=CONMEBOL.com|access-date=26 March 2022}}</ref> A total of 32 teams competed in the group stage to decide the 16 places in the [[2022 Copa Libertadores final stages|final stages]] of the [[2022 Copa Libertadores]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/documentos/manual-de-clubes-reglamento-conmebol-libertadores-2022/|title=Manual de Clubes / Reglamento CONMEBOL Libertadores 2022|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the group stage was held on 25 March 2022, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYST]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref name="Group stage draw">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/pautas-para-el-sorteo-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-2022/|title=Pautas para el sorteo de la CONMEBOL Libertadores 2022|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=18 March 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/parejos-grupos-en-la-conmebol-libertadores-20202/|title=Parejos grupos en la CONMEBOL Libertadores 2022|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=25 March 2022}}</ref><noinclude>

Teams were seeded by their ''CONMEBOL Clubs ranking'' as of 16 December 2021 (shown in parentheses),<ref name="ranking">{{cite web|url=https://conmebollibertadores.com/cards/NewsReaderWeb/ranking-de-clubes-conmebol-2022-es|title=Ranking de clubes CONMEBOL 2022|publisher=CONMEBOL Libertadores|language=es|date=17 December 2021|access-date=17 December 2021}}</ref> taking into account the following three factors:<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|title=RANKING DE CLUBES DE LA CONMEBOL 2021 SISTEMA DE PUNTAJE|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|language=es}}</ref>
#Performance in the last 10 years, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 2012–2021.
#Historical coefficient, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 1960–2011 and 2002–2011 respectively.
#Local tournament champion, with bonus points awarded to domestic league champions of the last 10 years.
</noinclude>
For the group stage, the 32 teams were drawn into eight groups (Groups A–H) of four containing a team from each of the four pots. The defending champions [[Sociedade Esportiva Palmeiras|Palmeiras]] were directly assigned as the top seed of Group A (position A1). The remaining teams were distributed into four pots according to their CONMEBOL Clubs ranking. Teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same group, excluding the four winners of the third stage, which were allocated to Pot 4 and could be drawn into the same group with another team from the same association.

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the group stage, each group is played on a home-and-away [[round-robin tournament|round-robin]] basis. The teams are ranked according to the following criteria: 1. [[Points (association football)|Points]] (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, and 0 points for a loss); 2. [[Goal difference]]; 3. Goals scored; 4. Away goals scored; 5. CONMEBOL ranking (Regulations Article 2.4.2).<ref name="regulations"/>

The winners and runners-up of each group advanced to the [[2022 Copa Libertadores final stages#Round of 16|round of 16]] of the [[2022 Copa Libertadores final stages|final stages]]. The third-placed teams of each group entered the [[2022 Copa Sudamericana final stages#Round of 16|round of 16]] of the [[2022 Copa Sudamericana]].<section end=Format />
